summary: Glass House Brands filed a Form 6-K attaching a Canadian Material Change Report dated October 9, 2026, disclosing the planned retirement of CFO Mark Vendetti, announced September 29, 2026 via GlobeNewswire and SEDAR+. Vendetti, CFO since 2021, will remain through March 31, 2027 while a successor search proceeds. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or transaction terms are stated. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer disclosure of an anticipated, orderly executive transition rather than a forced or abrupt departure; the succession timeline and permanent CFO appointment are the items to watch.
